module: Script-driven free camera (global, hidden): the pose (position, yaw, pitch downward, roll in degrees) is owned by the script every frame, with optional mouse look or manual movement. Allows animated flights (setTarget with duration, curve and callback), continuous smoothing (setSmooth), position locking (locked), disabling rotation (driveRot) or movement. Returns a constructor.
usage:
core_camera.setByName(0, 'scriptedFree', false, {pos = vec3(0,0,50), yawDeg = 90, locked = true})
local cam = core_camera.getGlobalCameras().scriptedFree
cam:setTarget({pos = vec3(100,0,30), lookAt = vec3(0,0,0), time = 3, ease = 'easeInOut', onDone = function() print('done') end})
notes: Convention: positive pitchDeg = looks downward (like setFreeCameraYawPitchRollDeg). Manual pitch limited to ±85 degrees.

locked = true: the script owns the position (no movement keys); allowLookWhenLocked = true lets the head turn; driveRot = false: setPose/setTarget ignore rotation (the user aims while a path drives the position).
dt is capped at 0.05 s in update. Default manual speed 30 m/s (x5 with fastSpeedModifier); look sensitivity 2.2; FOV 65.
setTarget locks the camera during the animation unless lockDuring = false.

C.desc: Scripted free camera mode. Fields: pos (vec3), yawDeg, pitchDeg, rollDeg, fov, locked, driveRot, allowLookWhenLocked, allowLook, allowMove, manualSpeed, lookSens, smoothPos, smoothRot, anim.

setCustomData.desc: Applies settings at once (called by setByName / setGlobalCameraByName): pos, yawDeg, pitchDeg, rollDeg, locked, driveRot, allowLookWhenLocked, manualSpeed, lookSens, fov, allowLook, allowMove, smoothPos, smoothRot; missing keys are unchanged.

setPosition.desc: Places the camera (and its smoothing goal) without animation; ignores nil.

setRotation.desc: Orients the camera from a quaternion.

setYawPitchRollDeg.desc: Sets the angles (nil arguments are unchanged).

setPose.desc: Sets the target pose (instant, or smoothed if smoothPos/smoothRot > 0) and cancels an animation in progress. Rotation is ignored if driveRot is false.

setSmooth.desc: Continuous smoothing time (seconds to reach ~63%); 0 = instant setPose.

setLocked.desc: Locks the position (the script owns it, no WASD).

setDriveRot.desc: Allows setPose/setTarget to drive the rotation.

isAnimating.desc: Indicates whether a setTarget is in progress.

cancelTarget.desc: Cancels the animation in progress (the camera stays at its current position, without calling onDone).

setTarget.desc: Flies to a pose over a duration. Without a duration (<= 0), applies the pose immediately then calls onDone.

opts.desc: pos (vec3), orientation by lookAt (vec3) or dir (vec3) or rot (quat) or yawDeg/pitchDeg/rollDeg, time or duration (s), ease (linear, smoothstep, easeInOut, easeIn, easeOut; smoothstep by default), fov, onDone (function), lockDuring (default true), forceRot (applies rotation even if driveRot is false)

update.desc: Applies the animation, look, manual movement or smoothing and writes data.res.pos / rot / fov.
